note: Tavan Bogd (Q143008) is the massif: Wikidata's P610 names Hüiten Peak (Q1091113) as its highest point, both rows carry 49.1458/87.8192, and the 4,082 m value on the massif cannot describe a second summit at the same coordinate. Tavan Bogd stays searchable as an alias.
The atlas row for Q215138 and the hand-written Monte Fitz Roy are the same summit at -49.271/-73.043. The guide row is kept because it carries the description, and Q215138 stays as its Wikidata id.
